steps.step: start a server on a fresh journal, with a backup root
every job runs to done; record each run's id, state and finish
pack and encrypt the off-droplet copy (age), delete the plain one
restore the key from its backup, decrypt and unpack the copy
durable-cli restore checks the copy into a fresh journal
a second server replays it: every run has the same id, state and finish
the restored server drains on SIGTERM and exits 0
